changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO banner ( id, title, subtitle, image_url, link_url, cta_label, eyebrow, trust_fabric_label, trust_shipping_label, trust_dyes_label, sort_order, active ) SELECT nextval('sequence_generator'), v.title, v.subtitle, v.image_url, v.link_url, v.cta_label, v.eyebrow, NULL, NULL, NULL, v.sort_order, true FROM (VALUES ( 'Minis today, memories forever.', 'Organic clothing for your little one''s softest beginnings — feather-light cottons coloured with azo-free dyes, made to be loved and passed on.', '/hero-carousel/slide-premium.jpg', '/shop', 'Shop the new edit', 'Premium · Thoughtfully designed', 10 ), ( 'Softness made for first cuddles.', 'Whisper-soft organic cotton in azo-free dyed hues — designed for the gentlest skin on earth.', '/hero-carousel/slide-organic.jpg', '/shop', 'Shop infant edit', 'Made for tiny ones', 20 ), ( 'All-day comfort for growing minis.', 'Crafted with soft, breathable fabrics and child-friendly stitching — built around the way little ones move, play and rest.', '/hero-carousel/slide-comfort.webp', '/shop', 'Shop the collection', 'Comfort first design', 30 ), ( 'Crafted with care. Made to last.', 'Premium children''s clothing built on certified organic cotton, azo-free dyes and child-safe finishing — thoughtfully designed for comfort, quality and the way little ones really live.', '/hero-carousel/slide-founders.jpg', '/about', 'Read our story', 'A note from the founders', 40 ) ) AS v(title, subtitle, image_url, link_url, cta_label, eyebrow, sort_order) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM banner WHERE active = true);
